proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer cannot tell whether sub-peak DRAM utilization (78-87%) comes from too little launched or resident parallelism, which launch/occupancy changes would fix, or from a hard bandwidth ceiling where only reducing bytes helps.

rationale.launch__waves_per_multiprocessor: HIGH -> grid already fills the GPU, leave launch geometry alone and attack DRAM byte volume via fusion; LOW -> grid too small to saturate the bus, shrink BLOCK sizes or split the work across more programs to raise block count
rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: LOW -> too few resident warps to hide memory latency, cut register/smem footprint per program or raise num_warps to lift occupancy; HIGH -> occupancy is fine, increase per-warp memory-level parallelism (vectorized loads, unrolling, num_stages) or treat DRAM as saturated and only reduce bytes
